data.title: 矢来美羽 · 厨房里的早饭
data.description: 早上起得有些晚，她靠在厨房台边喝水，面包还放在盘子里等着。
data.action: standing by the counter with a glass of water
data.promptProse: Sitting at a small wooden dining table in a sunlit kitchenette, Miu spreads butter across a slice of toast with a content smile. Morning sunlight streams across the table, illuminating a fresh ceramic mug of coffee and a jar of marmalade.
